title: update_terraform_var
description: Updates the value of an existing Terraform variable in a tfvars file or variable definition file.

var_name.description: The name of the Terraform variable to update (e.g. 'instance_type', 'region', 'db_password').

value.description: The new value to assign to the Terraform variable. Complex types (lists, maps) should be expressed as HCL-compatible strings.

file_path.description: Optional path to the specific tfvars or .tf file containing the variable assignment. Defaults to the root terraform.tfvars if omitted.
